The '''Asran system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was a source of high-quality [[Prismatic crystal/Legends|prismatic crystal]]s for [[Lant Mining Corporation]]. It contained at least three [[Planet/Legends|planets]] which were sites of LMC [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations.
